description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to add Redis as a grain storage provider within an Orleans application. It provides methods to configure Redis as default or named storage, supporting options configuration via delegates.

classes.name: RedisGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate registration and configuration of Redis-based grain storage in Orleans.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures Redis as the default grain storage provider, with option to pass configuration settings via an Action delegate.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Adds a Redis grain storage provider with a specified name, allowing optional configuration via an Action delegate.
